question: 每个区域有多少房源
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings_clean GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 按房型统计房源数和基础价中位数
reference_sql: SELECT room_type, COUNT(*) AS listing_count, MEDIAN(base_price_aud) AS median_price_aud FROM listings_clean GROUP BY room_type

question: 各区域平均可住人数及样本量
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, AVG(accommodates) AS avg_accommodates, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 各区域卧室数平均值
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, AVG(bedrooms) AS avg_bedrooms FROM listings_clean GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 不同房型的基础价平均值
reference_sql: SELECT room_type, AVG(base_price_aud) AS avg_base_price_aud FROM listings_clean GROUP BY room_type

question: 各区域基础价最低值和最高值
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, MIN(base_price_aud) AS min_price_aud, MAX(base_price_aud) AS max_price_aud FROM listings_clean GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 各区域超赞房东比例和样本量
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, AVG(CASE WHEN host_is_superhost THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS superhost_rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 按房型比较即时预订比例
reference_sql: SELECT room_type, AVG(CASE WHEN instant_bookable THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS instant_rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean GROUP BY room_type

question: 各区域基础价缺失率
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, AVG(CASE WHEN base_price_aud IS NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS missing_rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 至少有10个有效评分房源的区域平均评分排名
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, AVG(rating_5) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean WHERE rating_5 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY neighbourhood HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

question: 每个区域基础价不超过120澳币的房源数
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings_clean WHERE base_price_aud <= 120 GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 每个区域私人房间的供应量
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings_clean WHERE room_type = 'Private room' GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 不同区域酒店房型的房源数量
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings_clean WHERE room_type = 'Hotel room' GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 可容纳至少6人的房源按区域计数
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings_clean WHERE accommodates >= 6 GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 没有评论的房源按房型计数
reference_sql: SELECT room_type, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings_clean WHERE number_of_reviews = 0 GROUP BY room_type

question: 评分不低于4.8的房源按区域统计
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings_clean WHERE rating_5 >= 4.8 GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 比较超赞房东和普通房东的平均评分
reference_sql: SELECT host_is_superhost, AVG(rating_5) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean WHERE rating_5 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY host_is_superhost

question: 比较可即时预订与不可即时预订房源的平均基础价
reference_sql: SELECT instant_bookable, AVG(base_price_aud) AS avg_base_price_aud, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean GROUP BY instant_bookable

question: 按可住人数统计房源数和基础价中位数
reference_sql: SELECT accommodates, COUNT(*) AS listing_count, MEDIAN(base_price_aud) AS median_price_aud FROM listings_clean GROUP BY accommodates

question: 各区域最短入住晚数中位数
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, MEDIAN(minimum_nights) AS median_minimum_nights FROM listings_clean GROUP BY neighbourhood

question: 基础价最高的10套房源
reference_sql: SELECT listing_id, listing_name, base_price_aud FROM listings_clean WHERE base_price_aud IS NOT NULL ORDER BY base_price_aud DESC, listing_id LIMIT 10

question: 找出每个区域基础价最高的1套房源并保留区域内价格排名
reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT neighbourhood, listing_id, base_price_aud, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY neighbourhood ORDER BY base_price_aud DESC, listing_id) AS price_rank FROM listings_clean WHERE base_price_aud IS NOT NULL) SELECT neighbourhood, listing_id, base_price_aud, price_rank FROM ranked WHERE price_rank = 1

question: 评论数量最多的20个房源
reference_sql: SELECT listing_id, number_of_reviews FROM listings_clean ORDER BY number_of_reviews DESC, listing_id LIMIT 20

question: 平均评分最高的10个区域，要求每区至少20个有效评分房源
reference_sql: SELECT neighbourhood, AVG(rating_5) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings_clean WHERE rating_5 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY neighbourhood HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 10

question: 日历数据覆盖的最早和最晚日期
reference_sql: SELECT MIN(stay_date) AS min_date, MAX(stay_date) AS max_date FROM calendar_clean

question: 按月份计算可用日历记录占比
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', stay_date) AS month, AVG(CASE WHEN available THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS available_rate FROM calendar_clean GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', stay_date)

question: 所有可预订日历记录的总数
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS available_count FROM calendar_clean WHERE available

question: 2026年12月每天可预订的房源数
reference_sql: SELECT stay_date, COUNT(DISTINCT listing_id) AS available_listing_count FROM calendar_clean WHERE available AND stay_date >= DATE '2026-12-01' AND stay_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY stay_date

question: 各月日历最短入住晚数的平均值
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', stay_date) AS month, AVG(minimum_nights) AS avg_minimum_nights FROM calendar_clean GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', stay_date)

question: 2027年1月1日可用的房源数量
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT listing_id) AS available_listing_count FROM calendar_clean WHERE available AND stay_date = DATE '2027-01-01'

question: 评论数据的最早日期和最晚日期
reference_sql: SELECT MIN(review_date) AS min_date, MAX(review_date) AS max_date FROM reviews_clean

question: 统计2026年每个月的评论数量
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', review_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews_clean WHERE review_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND review_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', review_date)

question: 评论记录最多的10个房源
reference_sql: SELECT listing_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews_clean GROUP BY listing_id ORDER BY review_count DESC, listing_id LIMIT 10

question: 按区域统计评论总数
reference_sql: SELECT l.neighbourhood, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count FROM listings_clean l LEFT JOIN reviews_clean r ON l.listing_id = r.listing_id GROUP BY l.neighbourhood

question: 按房型统计每套房源的平均评论记录数
reference_sql: WITH review_counts AS (SELECT listing_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews_clean GROUP BY listing_id) SELECT l.room_type, AVG(COALESCE(r.review_count, 0)) AS avg_reviews_per_listing FROM listings_clean l LEFT JOIN review_counts r ON l.listing_id = r.listing_id GROUP BY l.room_type

question: 不同POI类型各有多少地点
reference_sql: SELECT poi_type, COUNT(*) AS poi_count FROM poi GROUP BY poi_type

question: 列出全部POI名称及类型
reference_sql: SELECT poi_name, poi_type FROM poi

question: POI坐标缺失情况
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN longitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_longitude FROM poi
